# Sourcing Sense

> Sourcing Sense helps procurement and operations teams in mid-sized European manufacturing companies use AI inside the tools they already pay for, mainly Microsoft 365 (Copilot, Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio). Founded by David Račak, an indirect procurement category manager with 8+ years of EMEA experience and a Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, based in Olomouc, Czech Republic. English-language site.

## Services

- **Procurement AI Audit**: maps processes, identifies what is worth automating, ranks opportunities by ROI and effort. Output: report and roadmap.
- **AI Sprint (one day)**: AI policy introduction, hands-on training for key people and a workshop on the top use case.
- **Advisory Retainer**: monthly support for teams already using AI.
- Free 20-minute discovery call: https://calendly.com/sourcing-sense/

## Contact
